artwork.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustrated key art and welcome-panel backdrop for the pirate sailing game Pirate Intelligence. A beautifully crafted 18th-century two-masted pirate sloop with a curved dark walnut hull, fine brass trim, billowing ivory stitched canvas, subtle crimson pennants and a tiny six-person crew, approaching a lush Caribbean island port with crooked terracotta roofs, palm trees and a cream lighthouse. A longboat rows toward a sandy cove in the foreground. Warm late-afternoon amber sunlight, clear deep teal sea with turquoise translucent shoals and fine foam, distant misty islands, a few gulls. Painterly storybook adventure illustration, sophisticated handcrafted miniature aesthetic, convincing nautical silhouette and anatomy, rich wood grain and fabric brushwork, cinematic layered composition. Wide landscape composition about 2:1, strong readable ship silhouette in the left-center, island to the right, comfortable dark-teal negative space along bottom edge for UI. Premium strategy-game cover art with high visual polish. No writing, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark. The ship is pirate themed but playful and welcoming rather than grim horror.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a six-portrait character atlas for a pirate crew management game. One single landscape image divided into EXACTLY THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, six tiles, no gaps or borders. Every cell is a distinct bust portrait against the same simple desaturated deep teal background; heads and hats must fit fully inside their own tile. Cohesive exquisite painterly storybook game art, expressive human faces, weathered 18th century pirate clothing, soft warm golden side lighting, visible brushwork, authentic brass and linen detail, warm adventurous humour rather than threatening. Each face at same scale, shown from chest up, looking slightly toward camera. Top left: Mara Morrow, a confident middle-aged woman pirate captain, red-brown coat, dark tricorn with small brass pin, dark wavy hair, warm tan complexion. Top middle: Barnaby Brisk, an older broad-faced male first mate with sandy-grey beard and hair, ochre waistcoat, dark naval tricorn, steady kind expression. Top right: Little Fuse, a wiry young woman gunner with short dark hair, single black eye patch, blue-violet bandana and dusty blue coat, mischievous smile. Bottom left: Peg Coppernail, a sturdy middle-aged male carpenter with ginger beard, sea-green bandana and green work vest, sun-weathered complexion. Bottom middle: Auntie Tallow, a warm older dark-skinned woman cook, white linen cook's cap and cream apron over dusty mauve clothes, amused smile. Bottom right: Pip Gulliver, a nervous young male navigator, round brass spectacles, pale blue scarf and soft pale blue cap, fair skin and tousled brown hair. No text, no letters, no names, no labels, no watermarks, no UI. Strict clean 3 by 2 grid of equally sized portraits with exact aligned cell edges.
